reviews.text: Pet grooming with highly trained staff, fair prices, and consistently excellent results.

My dog ​​came out wonderful.
I should start by saying that since he's used to being groomed, he hasn't had any problems with other dogs.
But I'd probably recommend making sure there aren't too many of them at once.
The girls were very good... I brought Molly this time...
Qualified staff and they treated my elderly dog ​​with so much affection.
Not very clean and unprofessional... bad experience with my cat. I do not recommend.

They have been washing my two dogs for at least the last 4 years. I have never had a problem. They do meticulous work, and listen to my requests. The dogs enter and leave happy. Their prices are in line with current prices.
